title: The Kalopaideia Old Norse Examination
instructions: Three hours, no notes for Part A; printed lexicon and grammar permitted for Part B. Honor code: you affirm by submitting that you used only permitted aids. A failed examination may be retaken after thirty days.

items.prompt_oldnorse: Gáttir allar, áðr gangi fram, um skoðask skyli.
reference: all doorways, before one goes forward, one should look about
every door, before going forward, should be looked at
all gates, before one walks forward, one should examine

items.prompt_oldnorse: Deyr fé, deyja frændr, deyr sjálfr it sama.
reference: cattle die, kinsmen die, the self dies the same
wealth dies, relatives die, oneself dies likewise
possessions die, kinsmen die, one dies oneself the same

items.prompt_oldnorse: Hljóðs bið ek allar helgar kindir, meiri ok minni, mǫgu Heimdallar.
reference: silence I bid from all holy kindreds, greater and lesser, sons of heimdall
hearing I ask from all sacred kindred, greater and smaller, children of heimdall
silence I ask all holy kin, greater and lesser, heimdall's offspring

items.prompt_oldnorse: Ór Ymis holdi var jǫrð of sköpuð, en ór beinum bjǫrg.
reference: from ymir's flesh was the earth shaped, and from his bones the mountains
from ymir's body earth was created, and from bones mountains
out of ymir's flesh was earth formed, and from his bones the crags

items.prompt: Parse the form berr. Give: person, number, tense, mood, voice.
Parse the form bárum. Give: person, number, tense, mood, voice.
Parse the noun form löndum. Give: case, number, gender, lexical form.
Parse the form maðrinn. Give: case, number, gender, article status.

sections.title: Part D — Multiple Choice (vocabulary and grammar)

items.prompt: How many cases does Old Norse have?
Which case is used for the direct object?
What is the suffixed definite article on maðr (man)?
Which meter is used in Hávamál?
